text: A side (pakṣa) with a doubtful probandum (sādhya) is one in which the mountain is the locus, with the presence of smoke as the reason. A side with a certain probandum is one in which the great forest is the locus, in the same context. A side with the absence of a certain probandum is one in which the great lake is the locus, in the same context. || 45 ||
